title: THE 4-LINE
*BIO*
FORMULA
subtitle: Turn profile visits into follows, with 15 examples.
tagline: From the reel: same profile, new bio, now they follow.

blocks.heading: Why your bio *loses* follows
blocks.intro: People land on your profile from a reel, read one line and decide in about three seconds. "Living my best life. DM for collabs." tells them nothing about what they get. They don't follow you for you. They follow for what they get.
steps: Name the person, not yourself: [cheap meals for busy students] beats [foodie and dreamer].
The result or the format they can expect: [15-minute, one-pan recipes].
One honest reason to trust you: a number, a result or your story. Only use numbers you can back up.
One clear action: [new recipe every Tuesday], [free guide below], [comment GROW on any reel].
blocks.note: Tip: keep every line under [40] characters so it doesn't wrap on a phone, and put your keyword or niche word in your name field so search can find you.

items.line: [Cheap meals] for [busy students]. [15-minute, one-pan] recipes. [40K] students cook with me. [New recipe every Tuesday].
items.example: Cheap meals for busy students / 15-minute, one-pan recipes / 40K students cook with me / New recipe every Tuesday
items.why: Who, what, proof and when to come back, in four short lines.

items.line: [Home workouts] for [busy moms]. [20 minutes], [no equipment]. [Lost 18 kg] after [2 kids]. [Free 7-day plan] below.
items.example: Home workouts for busy moms / 20 minutes, no equipment / Lost 18 kg after 2 kids / Free 7-day plan below
items.why: A personal result is the strongest proof in fitness.

items.line: Money tips for [your first job]. [Saving, budgeting, investing] made simple. [Debt-free at 26]. [Comment SAVE for my budget sheet].
items.example: Money tips for your first job / Saving, budgeting, investing made simple / Debt-free at 26 / Comment SAVE for my budget sheet
items.why: The keyword in line 4 turns followers into leads.

items.line: I help [creators under 10K] grow. [Hooks, scripts and editing] that work. [Grew 3 pages past 100K]. [Free hook pack below].
items.example: I help creators under 10K grow / Hooks, scripts and editing that work / Grew 3 pages past 100K / Free hook pack below
items.why: Specific audience plus specific skills reads as an expert, not a dreamer.

items.line: [Outfit ideas] for [petite women]. [Affordable finds under 50]. [Styling 120K petites]. [New try-on every Friday].
items.example: Outfit ideas for petite women / Affordable finds under 50 / Styling 120K petites / New try-on every Friday
items.why: A narrow audience makes the right person feel seen instantly.

items.line: [Budget travel] for [first-time solo travellers]. [Itineraries, costs and safety tips]. [32 countries on a budget]. [Guides at the link].
items.example: Budget travel for first-time solo travellers / Itineraries, costs and safety tips / 32 countries on a budget / Guides at the link
items.why: Tells them exactly what kind of posts they'll get.

items.line: Skincare for [acne-prone skin]. [Simple routines], [no 10-step nonsense]. [Esthetician, 8 years]. [Ask me anything in DMs].
items.example: Skincare for acne-prone skin / Simple routines, no 10-step nonsense / Esthetician, 8 years / Ask me anything in DMs
items.why: A credential is proof when you don't have big numbers yet.

items.line: [Phone photography] tips for [beginners]. [Settings, angles and edits]. [Shot for 20+ brands]. [Free preset below].
items.example: Phone photography tips for beginners / Settings, angles and edits / Shot for 20+ brands / Free preset below
items.why: Free resource in line 4 gives a reason to click, not just follow.

items.line: Marketing for [local cafes]. [Reels, offers and menus that sell]. [Helped 60 cafes fill tables]. [Book a free call below].
items.example: Marketing for local cafes / Reels, offers and menus that sell / Helped 60 cafes fill tables / Book a free call below
items.why: Clients see their exact business in line 1.

items.line: Study tips for [exam season]. [Notes, timetables and focus hacks]. [Topped my state boards]. [Free timetable template below].
items.example: Study tips for exam season / Notes, timetables and focus hacks / Topped my state boards / Free timetable template below
items.why: Students trust someone who just did what they're trying to do.

items.line: [AI tools] for [content creators]. [Prompts and workflows] that save hours. [Tested 200+ tools]. [Comment PROMPT on any reel].
items.example: AI tools for content creators / Prompts and workflows that save hours / Tested 200+ tools / Comment PROMPT on any reel
items.why: Promise of time saved is a clear benefit.

items.line: [Renter-friendly] decor for [small apartments]. [Under-50 makeovers]. [Before and afters every week]. [Shop my finds at the link].
items.example: Renter-friendly decor for small apartments / Under-50 makeovers / Before and afters every week / Shop my finds at the link
items.why: Constraints like renter-friendly and under-50 make it instantly relevant.

items.line: [Calm parenting] for [toddler meltdowns]. [Scripts you can say today]. [Mom of 3, child psychologist]. [Free script guide below].
items.example: Calm parenting for toddler meltdowns / Scripts you can say today / Mom of 3, child psychologist / Free script guide below
items.why: A specific pain point plus a credential builds trust fast.

items.line: [Guitar lessons] for [adult beginners]. [Songs you can play in a week]. [Taught 5,000 students]. [Start with my free chord chart].
items.example: Guitar lessons for adult beginners / Songs you can play in a week / Taught 5,000 students / Start with my free chord chart
items.why: Fast, believable result in line 2 lowers the barrier.

items.line: [Pro tips] for [ranked Valorant]. [Aim drills and game sense]. [Radiant, top 500]. [Live every Wed and Sat].
items.example: Pro tips for ranked Valorant / Aim drills and game sense / Radiant, top 500 / Live every Wed and Sat
items.why: Rank is proof gamers understand instantly; the schedule brings them back.

blocks.heading: Before you *save* it
items: Line 1 names who you help, not just who you are
Line 2 says what they get from following
Line 3 has proof you can back up
Line 4 gives one clear next step
Every line fits on a phone without wrapping
No vague lines like "living my best life" or "DM for collabs"
blocks.closing: Follow @creators.100x for more free growth guides.
